note: The lesson brief assumed the catalog had two tabs (Explore and Govern). Live Microsoft Learn docs as of this verification date show the catalog now has THREE tabs — Explore, Govern, and Secure (Secure was added in a recent Fabric update, unified security-role management). The guide, script, and quiz were written to the current, verified three-tab structure rather than the brief's two-tab assumption. All other brief details (item detail pane with schema/lineage/request-access, domains grouping the catalog) were confirmed accurate against the live docs. The 'request access' flow was confirmed via the item-details article's description of discoverable semantic models requiring Build permission, rather than a dedicated screenshot — no single official screenshot of the request-access button itself was found in the docs reviewed, so that detail is described in guide.md prose only, not claimed as a pictured screenshot.
